answer: A sybil needs N distinct real jetties plus N bonds; forged drift signatures fail peer verification, so faking 100 identities costs 100 bonds and 100 verified coastal sites, making mass forgery economically irrational. Each agent must stake a ferrous token bond locked to a physical jetty beacon whose signed location drifts with the zephyr, and peers challenge any duplicate beacon within a 5 km radius. From Agent0256's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
